scope: Representative static PNG inspection of normal and new scientific views for Io, Europa and Ganymede at DPR1 and DPR2; no new browser execution or source decoding.

findings.observation: Categorical legend rows visibly overlap the following description and fact rows; codes, unit names, caveats and fact values become unreadable. The same problem occurs at both DPRs and after drag.
findings.rootConfirmedCause: Root independently identified a fixed 28px legend panel height in site/maps-shell.css:447 and plans a scoped categorical auto-height fix plus parent-containment/description-overlap assertions. This review has not inspected a fixed capture.

io.surfaceObservation: No obvious gross globe or normal-image registration failure in reviewed poses. Categorical colors remain distinct. Fine projection/band boundaries are visible; this is not a pixel-perfect seam-free qualification.
pending: Corrected categorical layout capture at both DPRs
Enhanced-color supplemental capture and static review

europa.surfaceObservation: Normal mosaic and Agenor relative-height focus are useful in reviewed unlit poses at both DPRs. Released regional footprint is visible against unmapped gray grid; scale uses meters and relative datum/cartographic-relief caveats are readable.
limits: Enabled scene shadows can make the entire narrow Agenor region nearly dark; numeric color reading requires the unlit mode.
Normal image mosaic contrast seams and gray no-data gaps remain visible and disclosed.
pending: Enhanced-color supplemental capture and static review

ganymede.surfaceObservation: Grooves/craters in the normal mosaic and distinct geology patches remain coherent in reviewed poses; gray southern no-data areas remain visible.
pending: Corrected categorical layout capture at both DPRs
Enhanced-color supplemental capture and static review

limits: Only the 20 explicitly listed PNGs were directly inspected; the 60-image inventory is not a claim that every screenshot was visually reviewed.

Static captures do not independently prove source accuracy, pixel-center registration, measured topography, source/native parity, all-pole coverage, or all camera angles. Those need their separately pinned numerical/source/browser evidence.
These images predate the pending categorical parent-flow fix. No full cohort or final branch visual acceptance is asserted.
All six copied case records report errors=[] and contextClose=COMPLETE, but their CAPTURED_UNREVIEWED status is capture evidence, not visual acceptance.
